text:
Samir (CSM): Heads up — onboarding check with Harborline at 3pm. We're seeing a recurring latency spike on their assistant flow during peak. Health flag bumped to yellow. Thinking proactive move: swap to a compact int8 model + hybrid routing to secondary region during peaks. Want to propose this to the customer unless there are objections.

Ava (Solutions Eng): Do we have p99 numbers and a sample prompt set? If this is mostly long-context prompts, prefix caching might be higher ROI than straight quant.

Samir (CSM): p99 was ~1.2s baseline, spiked to ~2.4s on recent 8k token sessions. Sample prompt (redacted) pasted below. Most calls are multi-turn chat with repeated system preface.

Mira (ML Eng): Recommend compact-instruct-v2-int8 for a canary swap — quality drop measured <0.6% on our evaluation metric for their prompt set, but token cost down ~35%. Also enable prefix (KV) caching for the static system role. Suggest canary configuration and rollback triggers.

Jin (SRE): We can route up to 20% to the secondary region during peak without changing infra, but autoscale policy needs a small bump to handle bursty tails. I'll prep a temporary policy.

Samir (CSM): Proposed customer window: tomorrow 10:00–11:00 PST. I'll ask Harborline if they can accept a brief canary and provide live feedback. Ava — can you take comms?

Ava (Solutions Eng): Yep I'll own the outreach. @Mira can you drop the perf numbers and a short rollout snippet? Need something I can paste into the exec note. :+1:

Mira (ML Eng): On it. Quick rollout sketch below — canary 10% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m steps, rollback on >5% quality regressions or >20% p99 regression. Also enable short TTL prefix caching (~45s) for the static preface to cut repeated compute.

```yaml
rollout:
  canary_steps: [10, 20, 50]
  step_delay: 1800  # seconds
  rollback_triggers:
    quality_drop_pct: 5
    p99_increase_pct: 20
routing:
  primary_region: us-west-2
  secondary_region: us-east-1
  traffic_split: {primary:80, secondary:20}
model:
  canary_model: compact-instruct-v2-int8
  fallback_model: compact-instruct-v2-fp16
prefix_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 45
```

Jin (SRE): I can create the canary route and temp autoscale. Will tag infra tickets and schedule the change during the window.

DeployBot: canary created -> canary-1758205432-harborline-1 (status: deployed) :rocket:

Samir (CSM): Great — thanks everyone. I'll draft the customer note: outline safety nets, expected perf delta, rollback plan, and ask for live feedback during the window.

Ava (Solutions Eng): I'll send the note and include the YAML snippet. @Mira please DM the evaluation CSV so I can attach.

Mira (ML Eng): Sending eval now. Also add a short A/B prompt set so Harborline can sanity-check output quality before full rollout.

Samir (CSM): Sync scheduled. If canary looks good we'll propose a measured quant swap after renewal next quarter. :thumbsup:

Jin (SRE): Added an alert for p99 > 1.8s and error rate spike. If triggered during canary we'll auto-roll back.

Samir (CSM): Perfect. Closing loop after the test and logging notes in the account health doc.
